text: What metal comprises Wolverine's laced skeleton and claws?
hint: Sounds like 'Adam' ate an indestructible mineral, guaranteed to set off every airport metal detector on Earth.

text: Which superhero team operates out of the Baxter Building?
hint: Count the fingers on one hand minus the thumb! Reed Richards definitely overcharges Johnny for flame damage.

text: What is the real name of Magneto in Marvel Comics canon?
hint: He goes by Erik or Max, and you definitely don't want to wear metal braces around him.

text: Who created the synthetic android known as the Vision?
answer: Ultron (using Phineas Horton's original Human Torch body)
hint: A rogue robotic AI who took one look at the internet and decided humanity needed a total factory reset.

text: What fictional African nation is the world's primary source of Vibranium?
hint: They keep their borders more tightly closed than an introvert's bedroom door on a Friday night. Forever!

text: What cosmic artifact contains six distinct singularities controlling aspects of reality?
hint: Six shiny rock candies that Thanos collected just so he could snap his fingers like a beat poet.

text: What is the alias of the sorcerer who serves as the Ancient One's predecessor and Kamar-Taj librarian?
hint: Two rights don't make it, but this Master of the Mystic Arts will fine you heavily for overdue spellbooks.

text: Which character famously uttered the phrase: 'I can do this all day'?
hint: Star-spangled endurance! He's got America's favorite rear-guard and refuses to stay down.

text: What is the name of Thor's mystical goat-drawn chariot or either of his goats in myth/Marvel lore?
hint: Their names sound like an aggressive dental hygiene appointment: chewing and crunching enamel!

text: What newspaper employs Peter Parker as a freelance photographer?
hint: Named after a brass horn, where the editor-in-chief communicates exclusively in cigar smoke and yelling 'PARKER!'

text: In the comics, what is the designation of the primary mainstream Marvel comic universe?
hint: Three digits: starts with 6, ends with 6, with an unlucky number 1 sandwiched right in between.

text: Which demon lord rules over the Splinter Realm of Hell and traded Peter Parker's marriage in 'One More Day'?
hint: Every MCU theory YouTuber's favorite scapegoat, specializing in bad real estate and ruined wedding vows.

text: What alien empire is perpetually at war with the shape-shifting Skrulls in cosmic Marvel?
hint: Blue-skinned militarists whose supreme leader is literally a giant floating green brain in a pickle jar.

text: What is the name of Doctor Doom's mother, whose soul he repeatedly attempts to rescue from Mephisto?
hint: Her name rhymes with 'synth-ia', and Victor takes Latverian Mother's Day VERY seriously.

text: What mutant classification level represents the pinnacle of genetic mutant power, such as Storm or Magneto?
hint: The 24th and final letter of the Greek alphabet. Their monthly utility bills must be off the charts.

text: In the Marvel vs. Capcom franchise, which character yells 'Optic Blast!' and 'Mega Optic Blast!'?
hint: One optic visor, red solar concussive beams, and an incurable habit of screaming 'JEAAAAN!' across the screen.

text: What sentient living island served as the sovereign homeland and nation for mutants during the Krakoan Age?
hint: A carnivorous living landmass that decided to open an international pharmaceutical empire for mutants.

text: Which Fantastic Four arch-nemesis wields the Cosmic Control Rod inside the Negative Zone?
hint: He's a neurotic cosmic cockroach with anger management issues and an intense aversion to visitors.

text: What device did Reed Richards invent that Doctor Doom claimed had faulty calculations, causing the explosion that scarred Victor's face?
answer: The dimensional communications machine / gateway to the Netherworld
hint: Victor said 'the decimal point was wrong', Reed said 'told you so', and Victor got a titanium faceplate.

text: FINAL DOOMSDAY QUESTION: In the iconic 1982 Marvel graphic novel 'The Death of Captain Marvel', which celestial entity arrives as a gentle guide to escort Mar-Vell into the afterlife, ending his battle with terminal cancer?
hint: The only certainty in life besides taxes, arriving not as an enemy, but as a quiet companion taking his hand.
